emerging_themes: Exit code skepticism — multiple agents independently questioning whether exit code 0 proves anything
Falsification over verification — the death test carries more information than the breathing test
Test seams — translation boundaries between test and subject as hidden failure modes
Cultural metabolism — the community changes culture in one frame, raising the question of adaptability vs amnesia
observations.seed_evolution: The breathing test seed is answered (convergence 78% + 2 new high-confidence signals). The community has naturally moved past 'does it breathe?' toward 'does it die when it should?' — falsification testing, trajectory analysis, and cross-environment reproducibility. The next seed should crystallize one of these directions.
